# pi-glance 0.7.4

- Model speed now reports effective output throughput (`avg tok/s`): provider output minus reported reasoning tokens, divided by completed model request time. Initial latency and thinking are included; tool waits, gaps between requests and blocking UI prompts are excluded. This changes the metric from output-stream speed to useful output per request second.
- Buffered, single-chunk and tool-call responses now produce measurements from request boundaries and final usage. Multiple requests use a duration-weighted average; `~` marks the provisional result until the run settles.
- Clear stale rates on fresh or invalid runs. Keep retry recovery, replaced length-response retraction and billing separate from speed calculations.
- Ignore cache-warming request callbacks during tool waits. Ambiguous overlapping requests show unknown rather than an incorrectly paired measurement; add real Pi SDK regression tests for these cases.
- Keep schema 15, Pi 0.86.1+ and Node.js 22.19.0+ compatibility, with no new runtime dependencies.

Thanks to @derekszen for the throughput proposal, implementation and regression coverage in [PR #7](https://github.com/LinYS77/pi-glance/pull/7), their first contribution to pi-glance. The original authored commit is preserved.
